Based on the supplied bilingual editorial draft, this edition covers **2026-11-15 00:00–2026-11-21 01:45 Beijing time**; the final day is incomplete. Source dates retain their stated precision without invented timezones. Reporting, discovery and website-update dates remain separate; this is not an exhaustive global census.

本期为五篇新报道及一则既有报道补充，不新增正式或候选发现。既有 **33** 项正式发现、**44** 个排名、**11** 项待评估、证据等级及编辑决定保持不变；无排名调整。老虎墩与广西研究的独立学术深审尚未完成。

This edition adds five reports and one follow-up to an existing report, not formal or candidate discoveries. The existing **33** formal discoveries, **44** ranking positions, **11** under-review projects, grades and editorial decisions remain unchanged; there is no ranking change. Independent scholarly review of Laohudun and the Guangxi studies remains outstanding.

## 范围与后续审阅 | Scope and further review

本期包括中国、欧洲、中东及澳大利亚的报道。欧亚身高综合研究、Old Kapan、桃花河、反山、岭头上、Ballymacombs More Woman、Tell Kom Abu Billo 与 El Mirador 保留为编辑跟踪线索，未作新的候选或 HOLD 决定。美洲、非洲等地区的覆盖仍有缺口，不为地域配额将未核实增量写成新发现。独立深审顺序不构成年度排名。

The selection covers China, Europe, the Middle East and Australia. The Eurasian stature synthesis, Old Kapan, Taohuahe, Fanshan, Lingtoushang, Ballymacombs More Woman, Tell Kom Abu Billo and El Mirador remain editorial tracking leads, not new candidate or HOLD decisions. Coverage gaps remain in the Americas, Africa and elsewhere; unverified increments are not promoted to fill regional quotas. Review priorities are not annual rankings.
